channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: scavio-hermes-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides a hosted MCP server for structured data from 31 platforms and an Extract endpoint for URLs. It includes five workflow skills for product research, competitor analysis, price comparison, Reddit sentiment, and YouTube research.

item.title: agent-browser-mcp (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Agent-browser-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that enables AI agents to interact directly with a user's active Chrome browser session rather than a sandboxed environment. It works through a local bridge and a Chrome extension to maintain existing login states, cookies, and open tabs while providing low-level control. The project allows agents to perform page scanning, execute JavaScript, and issue Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) commands. It also supports physical hardware interaction, inc

item.title: ai-emotion-chip (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Emotion Chip is a Hermes Agent plugin that lets the agent add delivery cues such as whispers, pauses, and sighs to text it speaks. It renders those cues for ElevenLabs v4 or Fish Audio, and includes commands to check status and inspect how cues are rendered.

item.title: hermes-cloud-file-manager (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Cloud File Manager adds a Cloud Files view in Hermes Desktop for browsing, searching, uploading, downloading, and previewing files on the machine where the agent runs. Users can edit Markdown and text files with a review step before saving, and optionally browse Google Drive and import files to the agent’s machine.

item.title: heartbeat2 (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: HeartBeat 2.0 is a Hermes plugin that schedules agent turns for reminders, recurring work, roles, and watchers. Plain-code checks run at wakes and watcher intervals; the agent gets a turn when something is due or a watcher’s condition is met, in the same chat and on that chat’s model.

item.title: fish-audio-hermes (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Fish Audio for Hermes is a plugin that adds Fish Audio speech and transcription features to Hermes CLI, supported messaging apps, and the Desktop app. It supports voice selection, cloning and design, speech-to-text, live dictation, and voice replies; users can configure it with a Fish Audio API key.

item.title: hermes-personal-assistant (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Personal Assistant is a Hermes plugin that carries context, actions, evidence, and workflow state across conversations. It supports workflows including calendar and meeting preparation, selected inbox tasks, household administration, shopping, and travel; for supported actions, it can prepare the action and require approval before proceeding.

item.title: caduceus (Domain Applications)
item.description: Caduceus is a Hermes plugin that imports DNA data, Apple Health exports and health records into a SQLite vault on the user's machine. It provides cited answers drawing on those sources and research, can generate reports, and can watch for new research about the user's gene–drug pairs.

item.title: boardstate-hermes-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Boardstate is a Hermes plugin that lets an agent create and update a board with KPI cards, tables, charts, notes, and other widgets. The board appears in the Hermes web dashboard and Desktop, is saved in the user's Hermes home, and supports live updates on the open board.

item.title: glasses-platform (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Glasses is a Hermes Agent gateway plugin that connects smart glasses and other voice devices to an agent. Devices can send photos or voice recordings, receive spoken or text responses and reminders, and approve requests by voice or button; a terminal simulator lets users try the interaction without glasses.

item.title: hermes-teammates (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Hermes Teammates adds a configurable roster of named subagents, each with its own instructions, tools, and optional model. It supports background runs, follow-ups that include earlier results, and a Kanban lane where completed cards wait for approval before dependent cards proceed.

item.title: hermes-plan-mode (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Plan Mode is a plugin that lets Hermes Agent explore with read-only tools, write a plan, and require approval before implementation. After approval, it can carry out the plan in the same turn and track progress in a todo list.

item.title: dosbox-mcp (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: dosbox-mcp is an MCP server that connects MCP-capable agents to a running dosbox-automation emulator. Agents can use its tools for DOS input, screen text and captures, video recording, Lua scripting, and memory access.

item.title: sugar (Memory & Context)
item.description: Sugar is local-first infrastructure for coordinating coding agents through a durable SQLite task queue, with atomic claims and leases. It also provides project and global memory, searchable locally with embeddings or FTS5, and records task and harness activity in an append-only event history.

item.title: membase (Memory & Context)
item.description: Hosted Membase memory provider for Hermes with scoped recall, explicit saves and opt-in user-turn capture.

item.title: memoria (Memory & Context)
item.description: Native Hermes memory provider for Memoria Cloud or self-hosted APIs, with bounded recall and opt-in fact capture.

item.title: monitor (Memory & Context)
item.description: BetterDB Monitor collects and stores Valkey and Redis monitoring data, including slowlogs, command patterns, client activity, and latency history. It provides analytics for clusters, clients, keys, and anomalies, and can run with Docker, Kubernetes/Helm, or its CLI.

item.title: hermes-dreaming (Memory & Context)
item.description: hermes-dreaming is a deterministic nightly memory-consolidation tool for Hermes Agent. Its Python script checks conversations and stored memory, then reports candidate facts, conflicts, and other memory issues for the agent to handle through its regular memory tool; on quiet nights, it can skip waking the model.

item.title: lcm-x (Memory & Context)
item.description: LCM-X is a context engine for Hermes Agent that stores messages in a local SQLite database and compacts older context into hierarchical summaries. It keeps active context bounded and provides tools to search and recover details from compacted messages.

item.title: optmem-hermes-plugin (Memory & Context)
item.description: Local append-only Hermes memory provider with decay compression, BM25 retrieval and reversible native-memory migration.

item.title: hermes-gbrain (Memory & Context)
item.description: Community Hermes plugin connecting GBrain memory over MCP, with profile setup and maintenance helpers.

item.title: hermes-official-plugins (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Nous Research’s collection of first-party Hermes plugins for integrations, tools, providers, backends and Desktop extensions.

item.title: hwiki (Memory & Context)
item.description: Markdown wiki memory provider for Hermes with local SQLite FTS5 recall and append-only memory notes.

item.title: HyAtlas-Memory (Memory & Context)
item.description: HyAtlas Memory is a Go-based memory server with an embedded vector store and in-process BGE-small embeddings. It organizes memories into eight layers, supports Lite, Pro, and Ultra modes, and can retire memories with reasons so they can be restored.

item.title: ReMe (Memory & Context)
item.description: ReMe is a local-first knowledge base for AI agents that turns conversations and resources into readable, editable, searchable Markdown memory. It supports shared workspaces across agents and retrieves relevant passages using BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion.

item.title: superlocalmemory (Memory & Context)
item.description: Local-first shared agent memory with governed retrieval, MCP access and a native Hermes lifecycle plugin.

item.title: Compartment (Memory & Context)
item.description: Compartment is an encrypted, offline memory vault stored on the user’s computer for AI agents and MCP clients. It records memories with their source and date, supports expiration, and retrieves them using hybrid vector and keyword search.

item.title: hermes-plugin-holographic (Memory & Context)
item.description: Holographic Memory Provider is a local memory provider for Hermes Agent that stores facts in SQLite and supports FTS5 search, trust scoring, entity resolution, and HRR retrieval. By default, it runs without an API key, network access, or model calls; searching by meaning is an optional online add-on.

item.title: hermes-supermemory (Memory & Context)
item.description: Hermes Supermemory is a memory provider for Hermes Agent, offering semantic search, profile recall, explicit memory tools, and conversation capture. It can recall relevant memories before turns and save conversations as one document per conversation; hosted and self-hosted endpoints are supported.

item.title: hermes-sanctuary (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Sanctuary is a Hermes plugin that visualizes an agent’s tool use through Greek mythology characters in a live panorama. It tracks tool names, times, and counts, and shows alerts for issues such as repeated calls, fallback models, and budget overruns; it also includes a daily journal, day replay, and shareable image.
